errors.cannotReach: web_search: cannot reach the Metaso endpoint {endpoint} — try: check your network or proxy, then retry, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.missingKey: web_search: Metaso requires an API key — set METASO_API_KEY or `metasoApiKey` in ~/.reasonix/config.json. Get one at https://metaso.cn/search-api/playground
errors.unauthorized: web_search: Metaso API key rejected — check METASO_API_KEY or get one at https://metaso.cn/search-api/playground
errors.rateLimit: web_search: Metaso rate-limited — wait and retry, or get your own API key at https://metaso.cn/search-api/playground
errors.serverError: web_search: Metaso server error ({status}) — try again later, or switch engines in Settings (General page).
errors.parseError: web_search: Metaso returned unparseable response (HTTP {status}) — try again later
errors.dailyLimit: web_search: Metaso daily search limit reached — set METASO_API_KEY or get a key at https://metaso.cn/search-api/playground
errors.apiError: web_search: Metaso API error (code {code}: {message}) — try again later
